combo_label: The Human Body × Bell Ringing × The Titanic

entries.clue: Bony part of the face that drops open in astonishment
Middle part of the body that a belt goes round
Bulge that rises at the front of the upper arm when it bends
Principle named for a seventeenth-century printer, rung on odd numbers
Spark-gap apparatus in a room abaft the bridge, worked by Phillips and Bride
Day of testing at sea, just the one, before the yard handed her over
Pivoting arm at the rail that swung a lifeboat out and paid it down to the sea
Over five thousand changes without a break, and about three hours of it
Naval architect who drew her plans and sailed with her to note improvements
Fluffy striped section of a bell rope, gripped for the first of the two pulls
Springy gristle that shapes the nose and cushions the joints
